id: 18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 带把手机型气动组件的规范更换（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/18_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder（国内版）/src.py

points.K10: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
points.K16: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带前后把手的激光焊接机旁，机旁有一个小型空压机和过滤器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with front and back handles, next to a small air compressor with a filter, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，换另一款焊机的气动组件。
overlay: 带把手机型气动组件的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：水滴打叉的过滤器、气管接头、人脸前的气流打叉、气流箭头再激光
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a filter with a crossed-out water drop, a push-fit tube connector, an air jet aimed at a face crossed out, and an air arrow followed by a laser beam. No people.
shots.narration: 气要干净，管要插牢，用气有规矩。

shots.scene: 阿杰焊出的焊缝发黑、有气孔，焊枪喷出一点水雾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a dark porous weld seam while a little water mist sputters from the welding gun nozzle.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊缝发黑，焊枪还喷出水雾。

shots.scene: 老李打开空压机下方的过滤器，里面积着一层水
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the filter bowl under the air compressor and shows a layer of water collected inside.
shots.narration: 老李一查：气源进了水，电磁阀也坏了。

shots.scene: 老李拿出新的气动组件，小研站在一旁记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes out a new air valve assembly while the female graduate student takes notes beside him.
shots.narration: 先换组件，再把气源管起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 拆机维修，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，按说明书等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手和一个带蓝色气管的新气动组件
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, a hex key and a new air valve assembly with a solenoid, a small sensor and blue tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 两把十字刀、内六角和新气动组件。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下背面所有线缆和气管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs all cables and the air supply hose from the back.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉所有线缆。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角松开前后把手的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loosens the screws of the front and back handles with a hex key.
shots.narration: 松开前后把手八颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆右侧盖螺钉，从挂架取下焊枪，线缆在台面盘成大圈
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the right cover screws, lifts the welding gun off its holder and lays the cable in wide loops on the bench.
shots.narration: 取下焊枪，线缆盘大圈不急弯。

shots.section_title: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
shots.scene: 老李拆下挂架和线缆夹的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws of the gun holder and the cable clamp.
shots.narration: 拆挂架三颗、线缆夹两颗螺钉。
overlay: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖

shots.section_title: 拆挂架线缆夹，抬下右侧盖
shots.scene: 右侧盖向上抬起取下，露出黄色光纤
shots.prompt_en: The right cover is lifted upward and off, revealing a yellow fiber cable looped inside.
shots.narration: 把右侧盖向上抬下来。

shots.scene: 台面上铺泡沫，两人把机器侧放上去
shots.prompt_en: A foam pad is placed on the bench and two people lay the machine on its side on top of it.
shots.narration: 机器侧放，左侧下面垫泡沫。

shots.scene: 老李拆下机器底部的两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes two screws from the bottom of the machine.
shots.narration: 拆下底部两颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 细十字刀松开固定黄色光纤的小夹子
shots.prompt_en: A fine cross-head screwdriver loosens the two screws of a small clamp holding the yellow fiber.
shots.narration: 松开光纤夹的两颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 手指按下快插接头的释放环，拔出气管
shots.prompt_en: Fingers press the release ring of a push-fit air fitting and pull the tube out.
shots.narration: 按下释放环，拔出两根气管。

shots.scene: 两人小心把机器扶正
shots.prompt_en: Two people carefully stand the machine upright again.
shots.narration: 再小心把机器扶正。

shots.scene: 机内黄色光纤顺着原来的大弧度盘着
shots.prompt_en: Inside the machine, the yellow fiber stays in its original wide curve. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色光纤别弯折，保持原来的弧度。

shots.section_title: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线
shots.scene: 老李拆左侧盖螺钉，从主板拔下两根线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the left cover screw and unplugs two cables from the main board.
shots.narration: 拔下传感器线和电磁阀线。
overlay: 拔下传感器和电磁阀线

shots.scene: 老李把旧气动组件整个取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the whole old air valve assembly out of the machine.
shots.narration: 把整个旧组件取出来。

shots.scene: 新组件的两根线从右侧穿到左侧，插回主板
shots.prompt_en: The two cables of the new air valve assembly are fed from the right side to the left side and plugged into the main board.
shots.narration: 新组件两根线右穿左，接回主板。

shots.scene: 左侧盖两边挂钩对准机架销钉推入，拧紧螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The hooks on both sides of the left cover are aligned with pegs on the frame, the cover is pushed in and its screw is tightened.
shots.narration: 左侧盖挂钩对销钉推入，拧紧。

shots.scene: 两根蓝色气管插回接头
shots.prompt_en: Two blue air tubes are pushed back into their fittings.
shots.narration: 接回两根气管。

shots.scene: 光纤夹拧紧，气管卡好
shots.prompt_en: The fiber clamp is tightened and the air tubes are clipped in place.
shots.narration: 把光纤和气管固定到位。

shots.scene: 气管管口切平、无划痕，插到底的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a tube end cut square without scratches, pushed fully into a fitting up to a marked line. No people.
shots.narration: 插管前看管口：切平、无划痕。

shots.scene: 管口斜切、只插一半两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a tube end cut at a slant and a tube inserted only halfway. No people.
shots.narration: 插到底再轻拉一下，拉不出才算好。

shots.scene: 机器再次侧放在泡沫上，装回底部两颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The machine is laid on the foam again and the two bottom screws are refitted.
shots.narration: 侧放装回底部两颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 右侧盖装回，线缆夹、挂架拧紧，焊枪挂回
shots.prompt_en: The right cover is refitted, the cable clamp and gun holder are screwed in place, and the welding gun is hung back.
shots.narration: 装右侧盖、线缆夹和挂架。

shots.scene: 侧盖螺钉装回
shots.prompt_en: The screw on the right cover is refitted.
shots.narration: 焊枪归位，装好侧盖螺钉。

shots.scene: 把手装回，内六角拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The front and back handles are refitted and tightened with a hex key.
shots.narration: 装回前后把手。

shots.scene: 空压机后接着干燥器和过滤器，箭头表示气流
shots.prompt_en: An air compressor connected to an air dryer and a filter, with arrows showing the airflow to the welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩空气要经过干燥和过滤。

shots.scene: 小研按下过滤器底部阀门，排出积水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the drain valve at the bottom of the filter bowl and water drips out.
shots.narration: 过滤器的积水，按规定定期排掉。

shots.scene: 带油带水的气流进入焊枪、镜片起雾的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of oily, wet air flowing into a welding gun and fogging its lens, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 含油含水，会污染镜片、卡住阀门。

shots.scene: 气枪对着人脸和衣服吹的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an air blow gun aimed at a person's face and clothes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压缩空气不对人吹，不吹身上的灰。

shots.scene: 气流冲进皮肤、眼睛的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a sharp air jet hitting skin and an eye with warning marks. No people.
shots.narration: 高速气流会伤眼睛、钻进皮肤。

shots.scene: 开机顺序：打开气源，看空白压力表，再开机出光
shots.prompt_en: A three-step diagram joined by arrows: opening the air supply valve, checking a blank pressure gauge, then switching on the laser. No people.
shots.narration: 先开气、看气压，再开机出光。

shots.scene: 没有保护气就出光、焊点冒火星的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laser firing without shielding gas and a weld spot throwing sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没气就焊，焊不好还容易伤镜片。

shots.scene: 老李翻开空白说明书，对照几种不同颜色的气瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank manual and compares several gas cylinder icons of different colors.
shots.narration: 保护气用哪种，看说明书和材料。

shots.scene: 两个不同气瓶接在同一根管上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two different gas cylinders connected to the same hose, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不随意换气、不混接。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a clean filter, a push-fit connector, a crossed-out air jet and an air-then-laser arrow.
shots.narration: 气源干又净，气管插到底。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 不对人吹，先气后光，气种照说明书。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 气顺了，焊缝才亮。下次见！
